title: Fisherman Install Recipe
description: JSON recipe for the fisherman bootc install backend. fisherman refuses a key that is not here, at any depth (recipe_unknown_field), so each object is closed.

filesystem.description: Root filesystem of the automatic layout: fisherman's recipe.Filesystems (fisherman/docs/VALIDATE.md)

passphrase.description: LUKS passphrase; required (and non-empty) for passphrase-based encryption types. Frontends may write an empty string for the other types: fisherman's Recipe struct has no omitempty on it.

image.description: OCI image reference; omitted when installing the running live-ISO image

targetImgref.description: Override the installed image reference in the bootloader

store.description: The bootc-owned ostree storage of this computer.

digest.description: bootc_store.items[].digest of fisherman probe --json: the identity of the item, never a name.

sourceReuse.description: Install from an image that the bootc of this computer keeps (fisherman docs/SOURCE-REUSE.md, tuna-os/fisherman#384). Experimental: it needs "bootc_store_reuse" in experimental, an empty image and a registry targetImgref. Leave it out for the ordinary source paths. Never a default, never on live media.

flatpaks.description: Whether fisherman copies the host's system Flatpaks (/var/lib/flatpak) to the installed system. Absent: copy them. []: copy nothing. A list with entries also copies all of them: it is not a filter and nothing is downloaded; fisherman reports each listed application that the host does not have.

additionalImageStores.description: Local OCI stores available during an offline install. Leave it out and fisherman exposes the stores it finds on the host (the ones `fisherman probe --json` lists under offline.stores); [] turns that discovery off. Frontends write it only when the ISO's recipe names stores explicitly.

distroID.description: Short lowercase distribution id that names the OEM setup paths and services on the target (/etc/<distroID>/oem/). Frontends write the branding id; fisherman uses "bootc" when it is empty.

selinuxDisabled.description: true passes --disable-selinux to bootc, which adds selinux=0 to the installed system's kernel arguments. Leave false: bootc labels the target from its own policy.

hostname.description: Hostname for the installed system: at most 64 characters of dot-separated RFC 1123 labels, each 1-63 letters, digits and hyphens, not starting or ending with a hyphen. fisherman's rule (CheckHostname); fisherman/docs/VALIDATE.md lists the error codes.

unifiedStorage.description: Leave it out, or write false. fisherman does not pass --experimental-unified-storage to bootc: it accepted true and ignored it, and it now refuses true with the code unified_storage_unsupported (tuna-os/fisherman#366). It is not composeFsBackend and not additionalImageStores.

genericImage.description: Pass --generic-image to bootc install (skips the bootupd check). For ostree images that ship no bootupd.

zfsPoolName.description: ZFS pool name; only read when filesystem is "zfs". Defaults to "rpool".

imageType.description: Install backend. "ostree" is not implemented yet and is rejected.

flatpakVarPath.description: Path, relative to the target root, of the writable /var for flatpaks. Empty = fisherman auto-detects.

user.description: Account to create. An empty username skips the step.

username.description: Empty skips user creation. Otherwise ^[a-z_][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}$ and not a reserved system name (fisherman's CheckUsername; fisherman/docs/VALIDATE.md).

customMounts.description: Manual partitioning. When non-empty, disk/filesystem/btrfsSubvolumes and auto-partitioning are skipped.

varDisk.description: A separate disk to mount at /var.

diskIdentity.description: Binds the install to the device the frontend planned on: the serial, WWN and size that `fisherman plan --json -` reported for `disk`. When set, validate and the install refuse the recipe (disk_identity_mismatch) if the device now reports another value for a field that is set.

planBinding.description: Binds the install to the plan the user confirmed: `plan.binding` of `fisherman plan --json -`, with `read_image` spelt `readImage`. When set, validate and the install plan the recipe again and refuse it (plan_stale) if the digest differs; a malformed digest is plan_binding_invalid.

targetMount.description: Host path where the target hierarchy is assembled. Defaults to /mnt/fisherman-target. For parallel test installs.

luksMapperName.description: cryptsetup mapper name for the LUKS root. Defaults to fisherman-root; production installs leave it.

brewTap.description: Homebrew tap to add before OEM packages, e.g. ublue-os/tap.

override.description: The target checks that the caller accepts as failed: too_small (the disk is smaller than 50 GiB) and uefi (the machine did not boot through UEFI). Any other entry is override_unsupported. The checks that protect data (the boot disk, a read-only disk, a path that is not a whole disk) have no override. Needs a fisherman that has the target checks (tuna-os/fisherman#429); an older fisherman ignores the field. fisherman/docs/VALIDATE.md, 'Target eligibility'.

copyNetworkProfiles.description: Copy the host's NetworkManager connection profiles (Wi-Fi passwords, 802.1X credentials) to the installed system. Absent: copy only when the host booted from live media. true copies on any host; false never copies.

copyBluetoothPairings.description: The same choice as copyNetworkProfiles for the host's Bluetooth pairings (/var/lib/bluetooth, which holds the link keys).

extras.description: The desktop and product steps of the post-install stage. Each is off unless it is true. Absent: fisherman looks the image up in the catalog it finds on the host and uses that entry's values; an image that no catalog has gets none. An object, {} included, is used exactly as given. A frontend copies the object that the catalog leaf inherits (shared/catalog/README.md).

printServices.description: Enable cups-browsed, avahi-daemon and ipp-usb, each only when the installed image has the unit.

oemSetup.description: Write the first-login unit that installs vendor packages, enable the vendor's service when the image has it, and set a vendor menu icon.

audioNames.description: Write WirePlumber rules with friendly device names to the installed system.

bootSplash.description: Add `rhgb quiet` to every boot entry.

experimental.description: The experimental features that the caller accepts. A feature is experimental when no VM test covers it. filesystem "zfs" is refused (zfs_experimental) unless this list has "zfs"; send it in the same --partial fragment as filesystem. sourceReuse is refused (source_reuse_experimental) unless this list has "bootc_store_reuse". Any other entry is experimental_unsupported.

setBootNext.description: Whether fisherman sets the firmware's BootNext variable to the installed system's boot entry when the install ends. Absent: only when the host booted from live media. true: always. false: never. A frontend does not set BootNext itself.

locale.description: System locale, written as LANG to /etc/locale.conf of the installed system, e.g. de_DE.UTF-8. Empty or absent: the image's locale is kept. fisherman's rule (CheckLocale, code locale_invalid).

keyboard.description: XKB keyboard configuration, written to /etc/vconsole.conf and the X11 keyboard configuration of the installed system. On an encrypted install fisherman also gives the console keymap to the initrd. Absent: the image's keyboard is kept. A present object needs layout (keyboard_layout_required).

layout.description: XKB layout name, e.g. us or de; several separated by a comma (us,ru).

variant.description: XKB variant name, e.g. nodeadkeys; one per layout, separated by a comma, any of them empty.

timezone.description: IANA time zone that /etc/localtime of the installed system points to, e.g. Europe/Berlin. Empty or absent: the image's zone is kept. fisherman's rule (CheckTimezone, code timezone_invalid).
